$description: AUTHORED — the ColdLight font pool (the 5th token source). Every family here is vendored in assets/fonts/ (SIL OFL, licenses alongside) and generated by build.rs into the FONTS registry: registered at boot as FontFamily::Name(id), rendered on the Library fonts wall (gallery gate — a font that exists is on the wall). Classes: display (hero/eyebrow moments), retro (arcade/CRT accents), ui (chrome-default candidates), mono (readouts/code). Adding a font = drop the TTF + one entry here.
